peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (93.2): 6.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 41 of 44 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 20.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: City Hall MRT about 100 m, Bras Basah MRT about 350 m; closer than 36 of 44 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest ST. Margaret's School (Primary) about 1,340 m; more than 0 of 44 similar developments (the same as 28). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 250 m), more than 22 of 44 similar developments (the same as 10); nearest hawker centre Albert Centre about 960 m; nearest park Fort Canning Park about 270 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 690 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 800 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 910 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 960 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 1,010 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,080 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,240 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,280 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 188 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,458 new sales and 768 resales (2,226 purchases); new sales were 65.5% of these purchases. Subsales (70) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,280 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 768 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 31 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 768 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 868 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−11.5%). Planning-area private resales −0.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
